primary.title: Candide, ou l'Optimisme
primary.author: Voltaire
primary.rationale: Voltaire's most famous satirical novella, widely available and a cornerstone of his literary output.

primary.title: Dictionnaire philosophique
primary.author: Voltaire
primary.rationale: A foundational work of the Enlightenment, this philosophical dictionary is a key text for understanding Voltaire's thought.

primary.title: Lettres philosophiques
primary.author: Voltaire
primary.rationale: These influential letters offer Voltaire's observations on English society and government, contrasting them with France.

secondary.title: Voltaire: A Life
secondary.author: Ian Davidson
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive and well-regarded biography of Voltaire, offering extensive scholarly analysis.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Voltaire
secondary.author: Nicholas Cronk
secondary.rationale: A collection of essays by leading scholars covering various aspects of Voltaire's life, work, and influence.

secondary.title: Voltaire's Britain
secondary.author: Russell McEachern
secondary.rationale: Examines Voltaire's significant engagement with British culture and thought, providing a focused scholarly perspective.

suggestions.notes: Voltaire was a prolific writer, and many of his works, including correspondence, are available in digital archives. The secondary sources chosen are recent, comprehensive academic biographies and companions.
